declarations.name: Input
declarations.description: Source-bound React reference surface; callback entries describe React handlers, not newly dispatched DOM CustomEvents.

members.name: value
members.description: Controlled native input value; the reference text composition uses a string.

members.name: props
members.description: Complete inherited public React prop surface; exact pinned declaration and native event types are retained in sources/manifest.json.

events.name: onChange
events.description: Inherited native React handler; source event identity and payload are preserved.

cssParts.name: field
cssParts.description: Caller form-field arrangement, not an automatic Input wrapper. Semantic adapter part; actual React selector/ownership is in component.partBindings, not a promised Shadow DOM export.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: Visible native label with exact input association. Semantic adapter part; actual React selector/ownership is in component.partBindings, not a promised Shadow DOM export.

cssParts.name: control
cssParts.description: Actual native input source element. Semantic adapter part; actual React selector/ownership is in component.partBindings, not a promised Shadow DOM export.

cssParts.name: help
cssParts.description: Persistent caller help or error text. Semantic adapter part; actual React selector/ownership is in component.partBindings, not a promised Shadow DOM export.
